Method of Attack: Local code execution via vulnerabilities in installed drivers (GLCKIo and Asusgio) allowing arbitrary code execution, read/write access to IO ports and model-specific registers (MSRs), privilege escalation to ring-0
Exploitation of CVE-2018-18537, CVE-2018-18536, CVE-2018-18535 vulnerabilities
Impacted Systems: Motherboards, graphics cards, and peripherals compatible with Aura Sync
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerable drivers installed by Aura Sync utility
Local system access to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploits causing system crash, reboot, and blue screen of death (BSOD)
